summary: Release 30.1 del vocabulario Schema.org en formato máquina: tipos, propiedades, dominios (domainIncludes), rangos (rangeIncludes), jerarquía (rdfs:subClassOf, rdfs:subPropertyOf) y enumeraciones. Fija la definición de cada término y las pocas recomendaciones que traen sus rdfs:comment.

quotes.text: A correct [[gtin]] value should be a valid GTIN, which means that it should be an all-numeric string of either 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits, or a "GS1 Digital Link" URL based on such a string.
The numeric component should also have a [valid GS1 check digit](https://www.gs1.org/services/check-digit-calculator) and meet the other rules for valid GTINs.
The [[gtin]] property generalizes the earlier [[gtin8]], [[gtin12]], [[gtin13]], and [[gtin14]] properties.

The GS1 [digital link specifications](https://www.gs1.org/standards/Digital-Link/) expresses GTINs as URLs (URIs, IRIs, etc.). Digital Links should be populated into the [[hasGS1DigitalLink]] attribute.
The specific values of 'position' are not assigned meaning for a BreadcrumbList, but they should be integers, e.g. beginning with '1' for the first item in the list.

Every web page is implicitly assumed to be declared to be of type WebPage, so the various properties about that webpage, such as breadcrumb may be used. We recommend explicit declaration if these properties are specified, but if they are found outside of an itemscope, they will be assumed to be about the page.
The country. Recommended to be in 2-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1) format, for example "US".
For [[QuantitativeValue]] and [[MonetaryAmount]], the recommended type for values is 'Number'.

The identifier should be in the `XXXX:YYYYYY:ZZZ` or `XXXX:YYYYYY`format. Where `XXXX` is a 4 digit _ICD_ (International Code Designator), `YYYYYY` is an _OID_ (Organization Identifier) with all formatting characters (dots, dashes, spaces) removed with a maximal length of 35 characters, and `ZZZ` is an optional OPI (Organization Part Identifier) with a maximum length of 35 characters.
Typically the value is a URI-identified RDF class, and in this case corresponds to the use of rdf:type in RDF.

note: Las secciones son términos y la cita es parte de su rdfs:comment. Rangos, dominios, jerarquía e inversas (schema:inverseOf) no tienen texto citable: se leen de schemaorg-current-https.jsonld de la misma release. Las pautas de price, priceCurrency, Number y value («Use…») no llevan término normativo y no dan requisito.
